steps.heading: Upload a scanned PDF
steps.body: Select a scanned PDF in the upload area; supported size limits are shown beside it.

steps.heading: After upload, select an available OCR language
steps.body: After selecting the file, choose a language from the available control before recognition; no quality setting is shown.

steps.heading: Download the searchable PDF
steps.body: Download the searchable copy and check several pages for recognition quality.

steps.heading: Upload a text-based or OCR PDF
steps.body: Select a text PDF or an OCR-processed scan in the upload area above.

steps.heading: Choose the target language in the visible selector
steps.body: The target-language selector is available before upload; choose a language before starting the translation.

steps.heading: Review and download the translated copy
steps.body: Review the translated pages and text layer before sharing the output.

steps.heading: Enter an allowed public URL
steps.body: Enter a public web address in the URL field above; private network destinations are blocked.

steps.heading: Review the URL and start the conversion
steps.body: Check the URL you entered, then run the conversion. This form does not offer separate page-size controls.

steps.heading: Download the rendered PDF
steps.body: Open the generated PDF and review its page breaks, fonts, and images.

steps.heading: Select JPG or other supported images
steps.body: The upload area above lists the supported file types and limits for this tool.

steps.heading: Upload them in the order you want in the PDF
steps.body: Use only the controls shown in the workspace; file-dependent options appear after selection when needed.

steps.heading: Download the generated PDF
steps.body: Review the result details, then download and open the output to check it.

steps.heading: Upload the source PDF
steps.body: Select the PDF whose pages should become images.

steps.heading: After upload, choose an export resolution
steps.body: After selecting the PDF, choose an export resolution from the available control; the tool exports every page.

steps.heading: Download the JPG image bundle
steps.body: Download the ZIP and review the page images at the selected resolution.

steps.heading: Select a text-based PDF
steps.body: Select a text-based PDF. Scanned documents need OCR before conversion.

steps.heading: Convert the document and review its text layout
steps.body: The converter uses its built-in layout reconstruction; this page has no OCR settings selector.

steps.heading: Download the editable DOCX file
steps.body: Open the DOCX output and check paragraphs, tables, and page layout.

steps.heading: Upload a table-containing PDF
steps.body: Select a PDF that contains tables or aligned text.

steps.heading: Convert the extracted content, then review the workbook
steps.body: The conversion extracts available tabular content; it does not show table-region previews before running.

steps.heading: Download the XLSX workbook
steps.body: Open the XLSX output and check row and column alignment in a spreadsheet app.

steps.heading: Choose the source PDF
steps.body: Select the PDF whose pages you want to reuse as slides.

steps.heading: Convert the pages into slides
steps.body: The converter creates slides from the source pages using its built-in reconstruction behavior.

steps.heading: Download and review the PPTX presentation
steps.body: Open the PPTX output and review text, images, and slide order.

steps.heading: Choose a PDF
steps.body: Select a PDF in the upload area above.

steps.heading: Enter watermark text or select an image, then set opacity
steps.body: Enter watermark text or select an image, then set opacity. Placement uses the tool's built-in layout.

steps.heading: Apply the watermark and download
steps.body: Download the watermarked PDF and check that the mark is legible without obscuring content.
